description: Defines the CertDatabase class and its nested Observer class for managing and observing certificate database changes within the net namespace.

classes.name: CertDatabase
classes.description: Manages certificate database and observer notifications.

classes.name: CertDatabase::Observer
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to observe changes in the certificate database.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CertDatabase.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to receive certificate database change notifications.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from receiving notifications.

methods.name: NotifyObserversCertDBChanged
methods.description: Injects notifications to all registered observers.

methods.name: StartListeningForKeychainEvents
methods.description: Begins observing Keychain events on macOS.
